p: these are the names of the: Moses describes the wonderful order that God observes in performing his promise to Abraham; Ge 15:14.
land was filled with them: He means the country of Goshen.
knew not Joseph: He did not consider how God had preserved Egypt for the sake of Joseph.
get them up out of the: Into Canaan, and so we shall lose our conveniences.
they were grieved because of the: The more God blesses his own, the more the wicked envy them.
Shiphrah: These seem to have been the main of the rest.
women are not as the Egyptian: Their disobedience in this was lawful, but their deception is evil.
made them houses: That is, God increased the families of the Israelites by their means.
cast into the river: When tyrants cannot prevail by deceit, they burst into open rage.
